newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 6-,9-mo T-bills yields fall and 12-mo same.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 6-,9-mo T-bills yields fall and 12-mo same.

text.p: The average yields at auctions of six-, nine-month treasury bills yields slipped and 12-month yields were unchanged from the last sale on March 4, a central bank statement said on Thursday.
Six-month bills slipped to 32.03 percent from 32.08 percent, nine-month bills edged down to 34.92 percent from 35.03 percent, and 12-month bills remained at 38.02 percent.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 8.73 million UAH 13.25 million UAH
Amount sold 8.73 million UAH 13.25 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.53 million UAH 11.42 million UAH
The central bank sold 87,300 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 72,254 were competitive and 15,046 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 6.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 11.04 million UAH 33.76 million UAH
Amount sold 11.04 million UAH 25.57 million UAH
Actual amount raised 8.75 million UAH 20.27 million UAH
The central bank sold 110,400 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 86,300 were competitive and 24,100 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 6.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 12.09 million UAH 41.87 million UAH
Amount sold 7.009 million UAH 22.48 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.08 million UAH 16.29 million UAH
The central bank sold 70,095 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 47,095 were competitive and 23,000 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 6.
